QuestInfo.name: Guided by Candlelight
QuestInfo.0:
The temple said to be holding the records of Wu Shen was on the slope of Candlewick Peak, located at the edge of Xuanshan.
Talk to Feng to go there.
QuestInfo.1: Climb Candlewick Peak to reach the temple.
QuestInfo.2: The rumors claiming that Candlewick Peak was the sheerest climb in Xuanshan were true. Once Feng catches his breath, continue toward the temple.
